text:
Sam (AE): FYI acme POC load test just started and we're seeing 503/502 spikes. Demo in 45m, need quick triage.
Meera (Support): Thanks Sam — can you drop the failing request id or example call?
Sam (AE): calling the public demo endpoint, header x-customer: acme, body small chat payload. saw 30% 5xx in last 2m.
Owen (SRE): I can jump in. @Tim can you check autoscaler logs and queue depth?
Tim (Infra): looking. autoscaler shows scale-up requested at 2005129050 but VMs still provisioning. GC logs: "InstancePool: provisioning 2/4"
Jules (Eng): Are these Dedicated nodes or Hosted?
Sam (AE): POC is on a Dedicated trial pool (reserved burst).
Meera (Support): Any rate-limiting headers from our side in the responses? e.g. x-rw-rate-limit?
Sam (AE): sample response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
  content-type: application/json
  x-request-id: rq_9b2c3
  body: {"error":"capacity_throttle","msg":"temporary overload"}
Owen (SRE): That error string maps to our capacity-throttle path. Likely backlog exceeded router threshold and we reject instead of queueing.
Tim (Infra): Confirmed backlog spiked to 1.2k reqs, router threshold 800. Autoscaler triggered but warmup delay ~60s.
Meera (Support): For immediate mitigation can we lower router threshold to 1500 to reduce rejects while autoscaling finishes?
Jules (Eng): We can, but that risks higher latency and KV-cache pressure. Short-term okay for demo.
Owen (SRE): Also enabling burstpool fallback might help — route extra traffic to transient burst nodes.
Meera (Support): How quick to flip those?
Tim (Infra): I can flip burstpool routing in 20s. Doing now.
deploy-bot: deploy.started by Tim (Infra) at 2005129203 - change: enable_burstpool_fallback=true
deploy-bot: deploy.succeeded at 2005129210
Sam (AE): re-running the load test.
Sam (AE): Results: 5xx dropped to ~2% and latency up slightly. Demo team please confirm. :thumbsup:
Meera (Support): Good sign. Owen can you keep tracing request ids and follow up with customer post-demo?
Owen (SRE): Will collect traces for rq_9b2c3 and others and attach to the support ticket.
Jules (Eng): We'll schedule a config tweak: reduce warmup delay for autoscaler for this customer's pool and add pre-warm for demo windows.
Meera (Support): Also note pricing question: acme asked about burstpool billing — I replied it's metered separately; pls create a short note for GTM.
Sam (AE): thanks team. I'll update acme and prep a short postmortem for the POC meeting.
Tim (Infra): leaving monitoring watch for next 20m. ping me if 5xx climbs back.
Meera (Support): adding action items to ticket: (1) attach traces (Owen), (2) docs on burstpool billing (GTM), (3) autoscaler warmup config (Jules).
Sam (AE): :heart: great work.
